title: 第4章 君玲珑，七窍玲珑心，谁是君天帝？
content_zh:
君家斗武场，位于一处悬浮于虚空的巨型岛屿之上。
许多君家后辈，都会在斗武场内修炼。
其中不仅有擂台，还有各种检测修为之地，可供君家后人测验。
泰岳古碑，就是被君家的大能者，直接强行霸占过来，搬到了斗武场内，供族内弟子检测肉身修为。
此刻，在泰岳古碑旁，一位身着宫装的少女，正在调息，准备挑战泰岳古碑。
少女约莫十四五岁，一头金色的微卷长发，如同波浪一般披散而下，发丝晶莹，光辉耀眼。
她肤如凝脂，点绛樱唇，气质高贵娴雅。
年纪虽不大，但被紧身宫装包裹着的少女娇躯，却是玲珑有致，初露规模。
“不知这次君玲珑又会创造什么成绩出来？”
“她身怀七窍玲珑心，参悟各种功法速度都极快，想必各种炼体功法都被她练成了吧。”
“听说有几位序列，都想招揽君玲珑当追随者，但是却被她拒绝了。”
周围许多君家子弟，看着名叫君玲珑的少女，交头接耳道。
君玲珑，虽不是十大序列，但在君家也算是一位颇有名气的贵女。
因为她身怀七窍玲珑心。
这种心脏又被称为圣人之心，代表日后君玲珑若不陨落，则注定成圣。
虽说对于君家这种荒古世家而言，一个圣人倒也不算特别稀奇。
但放眼整个荒天仙域，圣人都绝对是站在顶层一列的大人物。
因为君玲珑有成圣之姿，所以一些序列才愿意抛出橄榄枝招揽，不过统统都被君玲珑拒绝了。
“镇天金掌！”
君玲珑抬起雪白如玉的素手，对着泰岳古碑轰击而去。

明明看上去是窈窕玲珑的娇躯，此刻却好似爆发出了无尽力量。
一声巨响过后，泰岳古碑上亮起光芒。
十五万斤！
“君玲珑好强，比上次又多增加了三万斤巨力。”
“是啊，一个普通天骄，肉身修炼到极致，也不过十万斤巨力而已，君玲珑已经冲破了那道关卡。”
四面传来赞叹之声，还少不了一群舔狗炽热的目光。
君玲珑雪白玉颜始终平淡，没有波澜。
这时，一道刺耳的女声响起。
“君玲珑，怎么过了这么久，才只增长了三万斤力气？”
一位蓝裙女子扭着细腰款款而来。
她面容妩媚娇俏，只是话语显得锋利。
“是兰清雅，第十序列，君仗剑的追随者。”
“她可比追随者地位要高，听闻君仗剑对其颇为宠幸。”
兰清雅并非君家人，而是第十序列君仗剑，从外面招揽的追随者。
君玲珑没有理会，兰清雅却是话语锋利道：“仗剑公子可是在泰岳古碑上，留下了五百万斤巨力的记录，是你的几十倍，但你却拒绝了他的招揽，现在知道自己有多么无知吗？”
兰清雅很看不惯君玲珑的假清高。
明明君仗剑都已经主动出言招揽她了，君玲珑却依然拒绝了他。
在兰清雅看来，君玲珑就是一个做作的绿茶婊。
“君仗剑虽然很不错，但还不是最好，我君玲珑追随之人，将是可镇压一个时代的存在。”君玲珑淡淡道。
没有人知道，七窍玲珑心，还有一个潜藏的能力，就是隐约可以窥见一角未来。

当然，这个能力很逆天，也无法主动施展。
君玲珑活到现在，只触发过一次。
在那一角未来中，君玲珑看到了一道模糊的超然身影，一袭白衣，背对众生。
亿万生灵，太古万族，都在他背后拜伏，高呼其君天帝的名号。
那时君玲珑就认定了，这一世君家定然会出一头真龙，镇压万古时空。
只是……
那一角未来中，被众生膜拜的君天帝，究竟是指君家的哪一位天骄序列？
因为这个疑惑，君玲珑始终没有追随任何人。
她一直在等待，那个最像君天帝的人出现。
君仗剑身为第十序列，虽然很强，但还没有给君玲珑那种感觉。
然而，兰清雅听到君玲珑的话，却是觉得十分可笑。
“呵呵，镇压一个时代，君玲珑，你这个借口，未免有些可笑了。”
哪怕是现役君家最强的第一序列，都不敢百分百说出这句话。
因为这是一个大争之世，万族崛起，天骄辈出，没有一个天骄敢放言，能够镇压这一个时代。
而就在这时，远处天空之上，一只白鹤，吸引了众人的注意力。
白鹤之上，盘坐着一位如同幼小神灵般的身影。
正是君逍遥。
他才只突破神藏五境，还没有获得御空而行的能力，因此只能乘坐白鹤而来。
“那道身影是谁？”
“看起来好年幼，这么小就来斗武场吗？”

一群君家子弟议论起来。
君逍遥从出生起，都一直待在天帝宫内，从未在君家走动。
因此，除了十八祖，一群族老和生母姜柔外，根本没有其他人见过君逍遥。
“嗯？他……”
君玲珑美目落在那道年幼的身影上，体内七窍玲珑心忽然颤动了一下。
心中生出悸动。
“不会吧……”君玲珑美目逐渐瞪大，一种直觉涌上心头。
白鹤落下，君逍遥脚尖一点，轻松落地。
“好俊俏的男孩子啊，好想捏他的脸……”一位君家少女美目放光道。
“可爱，想骑……”另一位身材丰满霸道的君家女子，美眸直勾勾盯着君逍遥，一脸痴女笑。
被这样一群如狼似虎的君家女子盯着，君逍遥感觉有些瘆得慌。
他的肾的确挺强，但终归还是一个三岁的孩子。
他可不想小马拉大车。
“这孩子气血太强大了，怎么感觉比我们都厉害？”
一位君家年轻人忍不住问道：“小孩，你是君家哪一脉的人，为何从未见过你？”
君逍遥随意说道：“你们当然没见过我，我是第一次从天帝宫出来。”
“第一次从天帝宫……”
那位君家年轻人说着说着，身体忽然一颤。
天帝宫，那可是君家地位最高的一批人才有资格居住的地方。
年轻人目光震动地看着君逍遥道：“你……你莫非是三年前的……”

“没错，我就是君逍遥。”君逍遥懒懒道。
一语落下，整个斗武场都是一片惊哗。
君逍遥如今可谓是君家最为神秘，身份也最高的后辈。
三年前出生，惊动十八祖，更亲自赐予其神子身份。
可以说，君逍遥如今的身份地位，丝毫不逊色于十大序列！
“拜见神子大人！”
斗武场内，所有君家子弟齐齐躬身一拜。
君玲珑眼露异色，但也是对君逍遥行了一礼。
兰清雅也是脸色变化，她一个外姓家臣，更是不敢得罪君逍遥，急忙躬身一拜。
看着那一片向自己恭敬行礼的君家子弟，君逍遥暗暗啧嘴，心里想道。
“不对啊，按照套路，这种情况，不应该是有人出来质疑我，然后被我疯狂打脸吗，表现地这么乖顺，还让我怎么装逼？”
君逍遥颇有一种打在棉花上，使不上力的感觉。
他还想好好找人装逼，不，是切磋一下呢。
不过君逍遥，还是小看了神子身份。
在场恐怕没有一个人敢对他有丝毫不敬。
“算了，既然没人挑衅，那我还是赶快签到吧。”
君逍遥微微摇头，直接是走到了泰岳古碑前。
这时，他脑海中传来系统的机械声音。
“叮，已到达签到地泰岳古碑，是否签到？”
“签到！”君逍遥心里默念一声。
content_en:
The Jun Family Arena is located on a giant island suspended in the void.
Many juniors of the Jun family will practice in the martial arts arena.
There are not only arenas, but also various places for testing cultivation levels, which can be tested by the descendants of the Jun family.
The Taiyue Ancient Monument was forcibly taken over by the powerful men of the Jun family and moved to the fighting arena for the disciples of the clan to test their physical cultivation.
At this moment, next to the ancient monument of Mount Tai, a girl in palace clothes was adjusting her breath, preparing to challenge the ancient monument of Mount Tai.
The girl was about fourteen or fifteen years old, with long golden slightly curly hair that spread down like waves. The hair was crystal clear and dazzling.
Her skin is like cream, her lips are rosy, and her temperament is noble and elegant.
Although she is not very old, the girl's delicate body wrapped in tight-fitting palace clothes is exquisite and has just begun to show her size.
"I wonder what achievements Jun Linglong will create this time?"
"She possesses an exquisite mind with seven orifices and can comprehend various exercises very quickly. She must have mastered all kinds of body-training techniques."
"I heard that several sequences wanted to recruit Jun Linglong as their followers, but she rejected them."
There were many Jun family children around, looking at the girl named Jun Linglong and whispering to each other.
Although Jun Linglong is not in the top ten, she is still a quite famous noblewoman in the Jun family.
Because she has an exquisite heart with seven orifices.
This kind of heart is also called the heart of a saint, which means that if Jun Linglong does not fall in the future, she is destined to become a saint.
Although for an ancient family like the Jun family, a saint is not particularly unusual.
But looking at the entire Wild Heaven Immortal Realm, the saints are definitely the top figures.
Because Jun Linglong had the appearance of becoming a saint, some groups were willing to offer her an olive branch, but they were all rejected by Jun Linglong.
"Heaven-Suppressing Golden Palm!"
Jun Linglong raised her snow-white jade hand and struck at the ancient monument of Mount Tai.
Her body, which clearly looked slim and graceful, seemed to burst out with endless power at this moment.
After a loud noise, the ancient monument of Mount Tai lit up with light.
One hundred and fifty thousand pounds!
"Jun Linglong is so strong. She has gained 30,000 kilograms more strength than last time."
"Yes, an ordinary genius who has cultivated his physical body to the extreme can only have a strength of one hundred thousand kilograms. Jun Linglong has already broken through that barrier."
There were sounds of admiration from all sides, and indispensable the blazing eyes of a group of licking dogs.
Jun Linglong's snow-white jade face is always plain and calm.
At this time, a harsh female voice sounded.
"Jun Linglong, how come you only gained 30,000 kilograms of strength after so long?"
A woman in a blue dress came in with a slender waist.
Her face was charming and delicate, but her words were sharp.
"This is Lan Qingya, the tenth rank, a follower of Jun Zhanjian."
"She has a higher status than her followers. I heard that Jun Zhanjian is quite fond of her."
Lan Qingya is not a member of the Jun family, but a follower recruited from outside by the tenth-ranking Jun Zhan Jian.
Jun Linglong ignored it, but Lan Qingya said sharply: "Master Zhanjian left a record of five million kilograms of strength on the ancient monument of Mount Tai, which is dozens of times yours, but you refused his solicitation. Do you know now how ignorant you are?"
Lan Qingya couldn't stand Jun Linglong's false aloofness.
Even though Jun Zhanjian had already taken the initiative to recruit her, Jun Linglong still rejected him.
In Lan Qingya's opinion, Jun Linglong is just a pretentious green tea bitch.
"Although Jun Zhanjian is very good, it is not the best. The people I, Jun Linglong, will follow will be able to suppress an era." Jun Linglong said lightly.
No one knows that the Qiqiao Exquisite Heart also has a hidden ability, that is, it can vaguely glimpse a corner of the future.
Of course, this ability is unbelievable and cannot be used actively.
Jun Linglong has only triggered it once in her life.
In that corner of the future, Jun Linglong saw a vague, transcendent figure, dressed in white, with his back to all living beings.
Billions of living beings, all ancient races, are behind his backThen he bowed down and shouted the name of his lord, the Heavenly Emperor.
At that time, Jun Linglong was convinced that a true dragon would definitely emerge from the Jun family in this life, suppressing time and space for eternity.
Just...
In that corner of the future, Emperor Jun Tian who is worshiped by all living beings refers to which genius of the Jun family?
Because of this doubt, Jun Linglong never followed anyone.
She had been waiting for the person who looked most like Emperor Juntian to appear.
Jun Zhanjian is in the tenth sequence. Although he is very strong, he has not given Jun Linglong that feeling.
However, when Lan Qingya heard Jun Linglong's words, she felt very ridiculous.
"Haha, to suppress an era, Jun Linglong, your excuse is a bit ridiculous."
Even the strongest first rank of the Jun family currently in service would not dare to say this 100%.
Because this is an era of great strife, with thousands of races rising and geniuses emerging in large numbers. No genius dares to say that he can suppress this era.
At this moment, a white crane in the distant sky attracted everyone's attention.
Above the white crane, a figure like a young god sits cross-legged.
It's Jun Xiaoyao.
He had only broken through the fifth realm of Shen Zang and had not yet gained the ability to fly in the air, so he could only come here on a white crane.
"Who is that figure?"
"You look so young. Are you coming to the fighting arena at such a young age?"
A group of Jun family disciples began to discuss.
Jun Xiaoyao has always stayed in the Emperor's Palace since he was born and has never walked around Jun's house.
Therefore, except for the Eighteenth Ancestor, a group of clan elders and his biological mother Jiang Rou, no one else had seen Jun Xiaoyao at all.
"Huh? He..."
Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes fell on that young figure, and her exquisite heart with seven orifices suddenly trembled.
There was a throbbing in my heart.
"No way..." Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes gradually widened, and an intuition came to her heart.
The white crane fell, Jun Xiaoyao tiptoed and landed easily.
"What a handsome boy, I really want to pinch his face..." A girl from the Jun family said with shining eyes.
"Cute, I want to ride..." Another plump and domineering woman from the Jun family stared straight at Jun Xiaoyao with a slutty smile on her face.
Being stared at by such a group of wolves and tigers from the Jun family, Jun Xiaoyao felt a little scared.
His kidneys are indeed strong, but he is still a three-year-old child.
He didn't want a pony pulling a big cart.
"This kid's Qi and blood are too strong. Why does he feel like he's stronger than us?"
A young man from the Jun family couldn't help but ask: "My child, which lineage of the Jun family are you from? Why have I never seen you before?"
Jun Xiaoyao said casually: "Of course you have never seen me. This is my first time coming out of the Emperor's Palace."
"The first time from the Emperor's Palace..."
As the young man from the Jun family spoke, his body suddenly trembled.
The Heavenly Emperor's Palace is a place where the highest-ranking people in the Jun family are qualified to live.
The young man looked at Jun Xiaoyao with shocked eyes and said, "You...could it be that you were from three years ago..."
"Yes, I am Jun Xiaoyao." Jun Xiaoyao said lazily.
As soon as he said this, the entire fighting arena was in an uproar.
Jun Xiaoyao can now be said to be the most mysterious and highest-status junior in the Jun family.
He was born three years ago, which alarmed the Eighteenth Ancestor and even personally bestowed upon him the status of the Son of God.
It can be said that Jun Xiaoyao's current status is not inferior to that of the top ten!
"Greetings to the Son of God!"
In the fighting arena, all the Jun family disciples bowed in unison.
Jun Linglong's eyes showed a strange look, but she also bowed to Jun Xiaoyao.
Lan Qingya's expression also changed. She was a retainer with a foreign surname, and she did not dare to offend Jun Xiaoyao, so she hurriedly bowed.
Looking at the children of the Jun family who were bowing respectfully to him, Jun Xiaoyao secretly clicked his tongue and thought to himself.
"No, according to the routine, in this situation, shouldn't someone come out to question me and then be slapped in the face like crazy? How can I pretend to be so obedient?"
Jun Xiaoyao felt like he was hitting cotton and was unable to exert any force.
heI still want to find someone to show off, no, I want to have a discussion.
However, Jun Xiaoyao still underestimated the identity of the Son of God.
I'm afraid no one here dared to show any disrespect to him.
"Forget it, since no one is provoking, I'd better sign in quickly."
Jun Xiaoyao shook his head slightly and walked directly to the ancient monument of Mount Tai.
At this time, a systematic mechanical voice came from his mind.
"Ding, we have arrived at the Taiyue Ancient Monument where we sign in. Do you want to sign in?"
"Sign in!" Jun Xiaoyao muttered silently in his heart.
